integrity: The proof derives the full common-factor language from phase alignment and mismatched-run endpoints; finite enumeration is corroboration, not a substitute for the proof. Bibliographic equivalence outside inspected sources remains possible. No independent scientific audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Pairwise distinct run letters and a fixed shared cyclic run order are essential; no claim about different cyclic orders, repeated symbols in a period, finite boundary truncation, or scattered subsequences.
title: The mismatch-gap basis for common factors of cyclic run words
